title.name: Orrick 4: Hiring, governance and legal pitfalls

overview.description: Run in the high case and in week 11 or 12. Contractors versus employees, international hiring, firing abroad, advisor equity, seed-stage governance, compliance, and diligence readiness.
objectives: Classify contractors and employees correctly, which is a real liability
Hire and end relationships internationally without creating an entity problem
Set governance that protects founder control without alarming investors

steps.intro: Run in the high case and in week 11 or 12. Contractors versus employees, international hiring, firing abroad, advisor equity, seed-stage governance, compliance, and diligence readiness.
instructions: Audit every current contractor against the classification tests.
Document advisor equity with a standard agreement and a vesting schedule.
Assemble the investor data room from the starter diligence room.

submission.description: Produce the Investor Data Room and log it against this module in Homeroom. Done means the artefact exists, not that you read the page.

resources.title: Orrick Tech Studio — employment, advisor and equity forms
IRS — employee or independent contractor, the actual test
